Python · Tier A

Bounded missing-reference evidence without provider secrets or automatic credential repair.

Details

Keep at most 32 distinct observations per routing authority. Repeated polling only increments counters; it cannot grow retained state or flood the server log. Facts identify the store epoch and distinguish an absent row from an absent namespace index entry. No provider URL, model, credential value, raw reference, path, user ID or exception text is recorded. This evidence describes the observation, not its cause.
